summary: STORE-004 Project Story™ tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 9 pytest cases pass. All 6 cinematic sections render in studio + public viewer. Share button copies correct URL to clipboard. CRITICAL gating test passes: 'Genera Project Story' CTA is correctly hidden for spec status=draft/review and shown for approved/ready; click triggers POST and redirects to new /project-stories/{id}.

observations.issue: On /studio/pulse, no <a href> containing '/project-stories' or text 'Presentazione Cliente' was detected during scan. Page also produced backend 503s on some dashboard widgets. The Project Story card itself may live on /dashboard or be conditionally rendered (e.g. tied to summary tile data that 503'd). Worth a quick manual check by main agent or a follow-up with broader selector.
Many repeated i18n missing string warnings (auth.login.*, nav.*) and a React 'setState during render' warning from LocalizationOverlay. Unrelated to STORE-004 but worth a sprint cleanup.

verified_features: BE POST /api/project-stories/generate-from-specification/{id} returns 201 with 6 sections; selected_products contain brand_name + display_name + entity_type
BE GET /api/project-stories/{id} returns full sections JSONB
BE GET /api/story/{share_token} public, NO auth, strips tenant_id + created_by
BE DELETE /api/project-stories/{id} soft-deletes (vanishes from list; detail 404)
FE Share button (data-testid='ps-share-btn') copies https://.../story/{token} to clipboard, label flips to 'Link copiato!'
FE /story/{token} public route renders 6 sections without studio chrome (no .ps-toolbar / .ps-back)
FE CTA gating: data-testid='generate-project-story' absent for draft + review, present for approved + ready
FE Click on generate CTA → POST 200 → window.location.assign('/project-stories/<new_id>')
action_items: Verify dashboard card 'Presentazione Cliente' actually links to /project-stories (could not detect href on /studio/pulse during automation; possibly on /dashboard or hidden behind 503 widget failure).
Optional cleanup: i18n missing keys (auth.login.*, nav.*) and LocalizationOverlay setState-in-render warning.
critical_code_review_comments: project_stories.py: list endpoint includes share_token but not tenant_id — good for least-privilege. PATCH does not validate status enum (any string accepted). Consider validating against {draft, published}.
Soft delete uses deleted_at column — confirmed list/detail filters with .is_('deleted_at','null'). Public /story/{token} also filters deleted_at — good.
Public payload pops tenant_id and created_by — verified at runtime. Still returns share_token in payload; acceptable since the client already knows it via URL.
Generate endpoint silently caps moodboard/material entity_ids to 24/24 and selected_products to all items — reasonable for cinematic view.
